userStories.title: Make issue-specify on-main writers ref-only (specify/abandon/merge)
userStories.description: As a cam operator chaining a file-local issue creation with a specify/abandon/merge in the same on-main session, I need specifyIssueOnMain, abandonIssueOnMain, and mergeIssueOnMain to commit via the ref-only commit-tree path so a stale local index can no longer silently revert issue files that a prior ref-only writeIssueFile added to refs/heads/main.
acceptanceCriteria: All three call sites in src/commands/issue-specify.ts (specify ~line 399, abandon ~line 447, merge ~line 546) call commitTreeToMain unconditionally (threading the existing localMainSha and the 'cam-specify-' tmp prefix); the `branchWasMain ? commitOnMain : commitTreeToMain` ternary is gone from this file. [oracle: bash -c "! grep -q commitOnMain src/commands/issue-specify.ts"]

The commitOnMain import in src/commands/issue-specify.ts is removed (only commitTreeToMain remains imported from ../git/on-main.ts). [oracle: bash -c "grep -q \"import { commitTreeToMain } from '../git/on-main.ts'\" src/commands/issue-specify.ts && ! grep -q 'commitOnMain' src/commands/issue-specify.ts"]

A real-git integration regression test reproduces the chained corruption: it creates 2 issue files via writeIssueFile (ref-only, so the working tree/index stays stale relative to refs/heads/main), then runs specifyIssueOnMain on main, and asserts BOTH pre-existing issue files still exist in main's tree (git ls-tree -r --name-only main scripts/cam/issues/ count is preserved, i.e. specify's commit added/mutated 1 file without dropping the 2 prior ones). [oracle: bun test test/integration/issue-specify-ref-only.test.ts]

The new regression test is a genuine oracle: it fails against the pre-fix code (commitOnMain working-tree path drops the stale-index files) and passes with the ref-only fix. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
userStories.notes: Edit src/commands/issue-specify.ts at the 3 ternaries (specify ~399, abandon ~447, merge ~546): replace `branchWasMain ? commitOnMain(cwd, files, commitMsg, spawnFn, writeFile) : commitTreeToMain(cwd, files, commitMsg, localMainSha, spawnFn, 'cam-specify-')` with the unconditional commitTreeToMain(...) call. localMainSha is already destructured from the checkMainUpToDate guard at each function. The `writeFile` injected option becomes unused for the commit path (it may still be referenced by other code — only drop it if it becomes fully orphaned and typecheck/knip demand it; do not over-reach, prefer leaving the option in the signature for callers/tests). New test file: test/integration/issue-specify-ref-only.test.ts — model the scaffold on test/integration/issue-file-on-main.test.ts (gitAvailable skip guard, mkdtempSync repo with real `git init` + initial commit on main, dirsToCleanup afterEach). Use writeIssueFile (src/issues/alloc.ts, signature writeIssueFile(opts: WriteIssueFileOptions)) twice to seed CAM-NNNN.json files ref-only WITHOUT a working-tree checkout, then call specifyIssueOnMain. Inject a no-op eventSink: () => {} so the default file logger does not crash the tmpdir repo (pattern: patterns.md 'Writer-owned event emission with default file sink'). GOTCHA (issue's spec.gotchas + CAM-90 sibling lesson): a single-write fixture masks this bug — the test MUST chain ref-only file -> mutate; the staleness only exists after a prior ref-only write. commitTreeToMain derives the tree from `read-tree main` (the real ref), so the working tree NOT reflecting the change post-write is the DESIRED invariant, not a regression (patterns.md 'commit-tree-to-main backlog mutation', 'On-branch migration vs commit-tree-to-main'). Re-read scripts/cam/patterns.md entries on the shared on-main module and the multi-file atomic CAS commit before coding. F-01/F-02 (pre-existing tests invalidated by the cutover): The cutover invalidates the on-main (branchWasMain=true / real-git Case B) assertions in test/commands/issue-specify.test.ts at lines ~428 ('success path (on-main): direct commit, writeFile called'), ~710 (Case B 'working-tree file gains specified stage'), ~858 ('abandon: success path (on-main) writeFile called'), ~1254 (real-git abandon 'file updated in working tree'). These now encode the FIXED bug. Rewrite them to assert the commit-tree/ref-only invariant (no writeFile call, no working-tree mutation; the change lands on refs/heads/main only) per the issue gotcha #2. Expect `bun test` to surface them red until rewritten — this is expected, not a regression.

userStories.title: Make journal-append and triage on-main writers ref-only
userStories.description: As a cam operator (or the autonomous meta-loop) appending a journal entry or running triage in the same on-main session after a ref-only issue filing, I need the journal-append (and --force replace) path and the triage path to commit via the ref-only commit-tree path so a stale local index can no longer silently revert prior ref-only-written files.
acceptanceCriteria: Both call sites in src/commands/journal.ts (force-replace ~line 396, append ~line 409) call commitTreeToMain unconditionally with the 'cam-journal-' tmp prefix; the triage call site in src/commands/triage.ts (~line 292) calls commitTreeToMain unconditionally with the 'cam-triage-' tmp prefix; no `branchWasMain ? commitOnMain : commitTreeToMain` ternary remains in either file. [oracle: bash -c "! grep -q commitOnMain src/commands/journal.ts && ! grep -q commitOnMain src/commands/triage.ts"]

The commitOnMain import is removed from both src/commands/journal.ts and src/commands/triage.ts (only commitTreeToMain remains imported from ../git/on-main.ts in each). [oracle: bash -c "! grep -q 'commitOnMain' src/commands/journal.ts && ! grep -q 'commitOnMain' src/commands/triage.ts"]

A real-git integration regression test for the journal-append path: it creates an issue file via writeIssueFile (ref-only, leaving the index stale), then runs the journal-append on main, and asserts the pre-existing issue file still exists in main's tree AND the journal entry landed. [oracle: bun test test/integration/journal-ref-only.test.ts]

A real-git integration regression test for the triage path: it creates an issue file via writeIssueFile (ref-only, leaving the index stale), then runs triage (with a rank change so the commit is not a no-op) on main, and asserts the pre-existing ref-only file still exists in main's tree alongside triage's rank mutations. [oracle: bun test test/integration/triage-ref-only.test.ts]

Both new tests fail against the pre-fix code (commitOnMain) and pass with the fix; journal append and triage remain idempotent (the no-op-skip-commit path still skips the commit when nothing changed). [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
Typecheck passes (bun run typecheck). [oracle: bun run typecheck]
userStories.notes: Edit src/commands/journal.ts (2 ternaries at ~396 and ~409) and src/commands/triage.ts (1 ternary at ~292): replace the `branchWasMain ? commitOnMain(...) : commitTreeToMain(...)` with the unconditional commitTreeToMain(...) call using the same tmp prefix the off-main branch already used ('cam-journal-' / 'cam-triage-'). localMainSha is already destructured from each function's checkMainUpToDate guard. New tests: test/integration/journal-ref-only.test.ts and test/integration/triage-ref-only.test.ts — model on test/integration/journal-append-on-main.test.ts and test/integration/triage-real-git.test.ts respectively. Seed the stale index with a single writeIssueFile (src/issues/alloc.ts) ref-only call before invoking the mutation. GOTCHA: the existing triage no-op guard (triage.ts:283, `changed === 0` skips commit) and the journal duplicate-cycleId guard must still short-circuit BEFORE the commit — verify idempotency is preserved (issue spec.gotchas: 'Verificar que journal append e triage continuam idempotentes e que o no-op ... ainda pula o commit'). For the triage test, ensure the seeded backlog has a rank change so `changed > 0` and the commit actually runs. NOTE (F-04): journal.ts and triage.ts emit no events and expose no eventSink option, so the 'inject a no-op eventSink' instruction applies ONLY to US-001/specifyIssueOnMain — do NOT go hunting for an eventSink parameter in the journal/triage writers; it does not exist there. Re-read scripts/cam/patterns.md 'cam journal append: deterministic housekeeping channel' and 'Shared on-main commit-tree module' before coding. US-001 must land first (same single-concern fix pattern; depends on the regression-test scaffold conventions established there). F-03 (pre-existing tests invalidated by the journal/triage cutover): The cutover invalidates test/triage.test.ts:478 (describe 'runTriage: on-main path' ~477, asserting git add + commit and writeFile-called, NOT commit-tree), test/commands/journal-append.test.ts:248 ('appendJournalEntryOnMain: on-main -- uses direct commit, calls git add + commit'), and the Case B (on-main) assertions in test/integration/journal-append-on-main.test.ts. Rewrite all of them to the commit-tree/ref-only invariant after the cutover. Expect them red until rewritten.
